about: Shared contract for the Hermes snapshot (the Hermes card at the top of Connections, and the #hermes page). The same bytes live in agent-team-template and agent-cockpit; a test in each repo checks they match. The collector writes `sample`-shaped files; the board reads them and, given `expectedShape.now`, must produce `expectedShape` from `sample` exactly. The board works out Running or Down itself, by `alive.rule`, and ignores - the gate refuses - any yes/no flag a file carries.

alive.rule: Alive when the gateway is found, its state is running and its beatAt is within withinSeconds of takenAt; or when any listed profile's scheduler beatAt is within withinSeconds of takenAt. Within means the difference either way. The board works this out itself; a file with any yes/no flag for it is refused.

heartbeat.at: the newest beatAt that proves the alive rule

names.profileRule: Hermes's own profile id rule (lowercase letters, numbers, - and _, starting with a letter or number), and the connection-name rule from tests/fixtures/connections-parity.json on top. A profile whose name fails is not written; it is counted in profiles.hidden.

profileRefuse.name: Donna
profileRefuse.why: a capital letter - Hermes keeps profile ids in lowercase

profileRefuse.name: .deleted
profileRefuse.why: starts with a dot - Hermes's own tombstone folder

profileRefuse.name: -work
profileRefuse.why: does not start with a letter or number

profileRefuse.name: über
profileRefuse.why: a letter Hermes does not allow in a profile id

profileRefuse.name: abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwx
profileRefuse.why: a stretch of 24 or more characters without a separator

profileRefuse.name: desk-helper
profileRefuse.why: contains sk- by accident, refused all the same

names.modelRule: The model is model.default from the profile's config.yaml. Only the last segment after the last / is kept, and only when it passes the connection-name rule; otherwise no model is written and the board says Model not known. The provider is model.provider, held to the connection-name rule as it is, and written only with a model.

modelRefuse.why: an address: its last segment has characters the board does not show
the start of a signed token
a stretch of 24 or more characters without a separator

rules: a block (install, gateway, profiles, and each profile's skills, sessions and scheduler) with any status other than found carries only status and an optional why
the collector always writes a why when a profile's sessions are unavailable; without node:sqlite it is: needs a newer Node
when Hermes is not on the computer at all, install, gateway and profiles are each not found, and nothing else is written
the default profile is the Hermes home itself; it is always first, then the other profiles A to Z, at most caps.profiles; how many more is in profiles.more
a profile whose name fails names.profileRule is not written and is counted in profiles.hidden; the board re-checks every name and adds what it drops to hidden
updateAvailable is written only from Hermes's own .update_check when it is younger than updateCheckMaxAgeDays and was made for the version installed

sessions count the top-level sessions (no parent) that started in the last sessionDays days: conversations are every source except cron, delegate and subagent; scheduled are cron; lastActiveAt is the newest activity of any top-level session
the file never says whether Hermes is alive; the board works it out by alive.rule from takenAt, gateway.beatAt and each profile's scheduler.beatAt
a file older than staleAfterHours is shown as Not checked for N h (N whole hours since takenAt), never as Running or Down
the collector writes heartbeat.path as { runtime, at } only when alive.rule holds, in the same commit as the Hermes file; the board reads it like any runtimes.yml heartbeat, with stale_after_minutes
the board shows at most maxComputersShown computers, newest takenAt first

aliveExamples.why: the gateway is running and stamped 48 seconds before the check
the gateway says running, but its last stamp is six minutes old
exactly five minutes is still within
five minutes and one second after the check is not
a stopped gateway with a fresh stamp is not proof
only running counts for the gateway, not degraded
a running gateway with no stamp is not proof
no gateway, but one profile's scheduler beat two minutes before the check
both prove it; the newer time is the heartbeat
a scheduler beat four minutes after the check (it beat while the collector was reading) still counts
scheduler beats three hours old are not proof

wordExamples.why: the gateway is stopped and no scheduler beat is near the check
exactly staleAfterHours old is still a reading, so it says Down, not Not checked
the newest reading is nine and a half hours old: whole hours, rounded down
